label: Custom task fields
description: Your own fields on every task, shown in the Advanced tab of the task form, on the task page and in Claude's brief. Each key maps to a label and a type: text, number, date, url or select (select needs "options"). Example: {"target_version": {"label": "Target version", "type": "text"}, "effort_source": {"label": "Estimated by", "type": "select", "options": ["me", "Claude", "reviewer"]}}. Removing a field hides its values; they stay stored.
